editorNote: Demo edition — these sample records show how release feeds can be grouped into a practical developer desk. They do not describe a particular software release.

stories.headline: Demo sample: a versioned client update
stories.summary: This sample story represents a GitHub release entry with release notes and a versioned artifact. It is a display fixture, not a claim about a newly published package.
stories.whyItMatters: Release sources make implementation changes easier to track than broad product-news coverage alone.
